elements.name: title
elements.text: Backup: evidence and the remaining design decisions

elements.name: subtitle
elements.text: The proposal has explicit integration questions rather than implied capabilities

elements.name: source
elements.text: Source checks dated October 26, 2026. No new runtime or scientific trial ran for this presentation.

Evidence or gap	What it establishes or requires
M1 scheduler and native adapter	Frozen-plan execution exists. Its adapter narrows upstream orchestration.
Pinned SDK goal and journal code	Persistent goal records and signature/run-scoped replay are reuse candidates.
Magentic-One and planning research	Support mechanisms and test hypotheses, not AI4R performance claims.
Cross-batch accepted artifacts	Define identity, scope, dependencies, authorization and original acceptance proof.
Concurrent live patches	Choose only if needed. Require atomic revision checks and invalidation closure.

elements.name: remaining
elements.text:
Before implementation: settle transfer semantics and the first boundary.
Before benefit claims: freeze quality/cost criteria, then run the comparison.
